247A: The bani 'Var' of Guru Arjan Dev ji in Raag Basant.
MDZ7: The Eternal Being is one, and he is met by the grace of the Satguru.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the True Guru's grace, He is attained.
D7P4: Mahal = the body {Note: here the word 'mahal' stands in place of the word 'mahala'}. Mahal 5 = the fifth body, Guru Nanak's fifth body, that is, Guru Arjan. Haria = one having spiritual life.
Remembering the Lord's Name, become one who has spiritual life (as a tree gets its greenness when it is given water).
Meditate on the Lord's Name, and blossom forth in green abundance.
Contemplating God's Name, flower you, O my brother.
O brother! By (dhiae) repeating the Name of Hari become green — the meaning being, become possessed of virtues.
YBGD: Karam = through the writ of grace. Ih rut = this season of the human body, for the repeating of the Name. Suhaee = beautiful.
This beautiful season (of human birth, for the repeating of the Name) is obtained only when the writ of grace written (by the Lord according to earlier deeds) comes to light.
By your high destiny, you have been blessed with this wondrous spring of the soul.
In accordance with the writ of destiny, you are blessed with this beauteous season.
But only if good deeds have been written is the meditation upon Hari obtained. For the repeating of the Name this human body, which is the (rut) season, is beautiful and fair.
P162: (As with the rain) the forest, the vegetation and the whole world blossom, (so every hair of that person blossoms who) obtains the nectar-fruit that is the Name.
See all the three worlds in bloom, and obtain the Fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.
Obtaining the ambrosial fruit of the Name the woods, grass and the three worlds have bloomed.
That power by which the forest, the grass and the universe of the three worlds are blossoming — that conscious power, which is of the form of the nectar-fruit, has been obtained.
CQ20: Meeting the Guru, comfort arises (within his heart), and the filth of his mind is washed away.
Meeting with the Holy Saints, peace wells up, and all sins are erased.
Meeting with the saints bliss wells up and all the darkness of sins is dispelled.
From the meeting with the Sadhu, comfort arises; by this very means, through the holy congregation, comfort has come to us, and from the inner being the covering that is ignorance has fallen away.
AJ81: Nanak (too) remembers the Lord's Name alone (and the person who remembers it) does not have to wander again and again in the round of birth and death. ||1||
O Nanak, remember in meditation the One Name, and you shall never again be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.. ||1||
Nanak utters but the One Lord's Name, and he shall wander not in existences again.
Sri Guru ji says: by the remembering of the one Name one does not run again and again through the eighty-four lakh births — the meaning being, one becomes free of birth and death. ||1||
G425: Panje = all five of the vices such as lust. Bali = powerful. Dhoa = an offering.
The person who has presented the true offering (of the remembrance of the Lord, in the Lord's presence) — the Lord has bound down all five of his mighty vices, lust and the rest,
The five powerful desires are bound down, when you lean on the True Lord.
Obtaining the support of the True Name, I have chained the five very powerful demons.
The true one who is Parmesvar — taking his (dhoa) support or union, the one who has bound the five vices such as lust,
SNYD: Japaian = he made him repeat. Vich = within his heart. Dai = the merciful Lord.
the merciful Lord, standing within, has settled his own feet within that person's heart — that is, he himself has made him repeat the Name,
The Lord Himself leads us to dwell at His Feet. He stands right in our midst.
Standing within my mind, the Lord has made me meditate on His feet.
within him (dai) Waheguru himself, standing — that is, becoming his protector — has made him repeat his own feet; the meaning being, he has made him meditate upon his own feet.
X7HW: Sabh = all. Niroa = free of disease, healthy.
(and because of this) all his ailments and anxieties are wiped away, and he remains for ever pure of soul and free of disease.
All sorrows and sicknesses are eradicated, and you become ever-fresh and rejuvenated.
I am rid of all the ailments and sorrow, and am ever hale and hearty.
His ailments and sorrows have all been removed, and he has become daily (nava) new — that is, joyful — and (niroa) free of disease; the meaning being, free of the disease of pride.
L5MY: Rain = night. Moa = death, the round of birth and death.
That person remembers the Lord's Name day and night, and he does not have to go through the round of birth and death.
Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You shall never again die.
Contemplating the Lord's Name day and night I shall die not again.
So he meditates upon the Name night and day, and then he does not obtain withering — the meaning being, he does not become full of grief; or he does not obtain (moa) death.
YU5V: O Nanak! The Lord from whom he was born, (by the grace of remembrance) he becomes the very form of that Lord. ||2||
And the One, from whom we came, O Nanak, into Him we merge once again. ||2||
O Nanak, I have ultimately become He, from whom I had issued forth.
Sri Guru ji says: that from which the being had arisen, that itself it became again — the meaning being, it became one with Parmesvar. ||2|| ☬ Question:
6Q3K: Kah mah = in what? Samavai = it merges.
(No one can tell) from where the Lord arises, where he dwells, and where he merges.
Where do we come from? Where do we live? Where do we go in the end?
Where from springs the man, where lives he, and in what does he merge?

From where does the world arise, and where does it stay settled, and into what does it merge at the end? ☬ The answer to this: the Parmesvar from whom the world has arisen, in him it is settled. And again, at the end too it has become that very form — the meaning being, an imagined thing is not separate from its ground. In this is the manner of the seeker's contemplation, the meaning being, contemplate in this way; or, on the side of the question, this is the answer.
0Y5Q: All beings are the creation of the Master-Lord; no one at all can set a price upon (the qualities of his own maker).
All creatures belong to God, our Lord and Master. Who can place a value on Him?
Men and all other beings belong to the Lord. Who can appraise their worth?

The beings small and great are all (khasam) Parmesvar's, and who is there to set his price? The meaning being, that Master alone is the one who can set the price. No other can know it at all — the meaning being, within Ishvar's resolve the creation takes its standing.
513W: Kahan = they speak. Suhavai = they appear beautiful.
Those who utter the qualities of that Lord, who remember them and who hear them, those devotees become beautiful (in their living).
Those who meditate, listen and chant, those devotees are blessed and beautified.
Beauteous are the saints, who ever utter, contemplate and hear the Lord's Name.
Those who with speech utter the Name of Hari, and with the mind meditate upon him, and daily hear the praise of Hari, those devotees are fair.
RJPT: Lavai na lavai = he cannot come near in comparison. Agochar = a-go-char. Go = the senses
The Lord is unreachable, beyond the reach of the senses, the master of all; no one at all can come near him in comparison.
The Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; there is no other equal to Him.
Inaccessible and Inapprehensible is the Lord. None else can equal Him.
That (sahibo) Waheguru is unreachable and beyond the senses; no second one is set (lavai) as his like.
4MBG: Gur = the Guru. Updesia = he has shown him near at hand. Sach = the ever-abiding Lord ||3||1||
Nanak recites the praise of that ever-abiding Lord; the perfect Guru has shown that Lord near at hand (has shown him dwelling within). ||3||1||
The Perfect Guru has taught this Truth. Nanak proclaims it to the world. ||3||1||
The perfect Guru has instructed Nanak in Truth and this is what he preaches into the world.

The perfect Sri Guru Ramdas ji gave this true teaching. Sri Guru ji says: that very thing I recite to those fit to receive it — apart from the one Parmesvar there is no other at all. ||3||1|| ☬ Showing his equal pervading, he says:
